translation_status: English draft export; current insertion and review status tracked separately in docs/translation-status.json

rows.en: Ymir: "...*sigh*"
Touya: "Hm? What's wrong? Why the sigh?"
Ymir: "Oh, Touya...
We got permission to investigate the royal capital, but...
they wouldn't give us permission to dock.
When I ask why, they just say it's a safety issue
and won't listen..."
Yamato: "Isn't that just harassment, you knyow?"
Ymir: "Yes. I never thought they'd go this far..."
Sisk: "We'll soon arrive at the point
where the signature was detected."
Ymir: "Let's investigate, anyway. Please."
Sisk: "Understood."
Ymir: "How is it?"
Sisk: "...Nothing. There's no sign of a matching signature."
Miyasco: "Could it have gone somewhere else already?"
Ymir: "It bothers me that the signature only appeared
for an instant... Anyway, please keep looking."
Clovis: "Then let's head into the capital..."
Touya: "That's fine, but where are you dropping us off?"
Derock: "That patch of forest looks good, you know."
Ymir: "Yes. Let's use that spot."
Touya: "But is it safe for us to just walk into the capital?
I'd rather not get detained out of nowhere."
Ymir: "We'll be all right.
We're officially an organization affiliated with the Holy Land.
At worst, they should only be able to harass us with delays.
Detaining us unlawfully would violate international treaties
and turn public opinion against them.
Surely they won't go that far."
Celica: "Well then, have fun, everyone!"
Touya: "Huh? Aren't you going to see Lodis?"
Celica: "Hmm... I'll pass.
Besides, I think I'm close to a breakthrough
on a countermeasure to Ze=Ode's special field."
Fain: "What? You're staying here, Princess?
M-mmm..."
Kasumi: "Well, we'll be going, then."
Fain: "What?! K-Kasumi is going...?
Then I... No, my duty is to protect the princess.
Ah, but...!"
Touya: "Come on, let's go."
Kasumi: "H-hey, is it okay to leave Fain like that?"
Touya: "Yeah. Letting him get it out of his system is best for him."
Kasumi: "Y-you think so?"
Fain: "Ooooh! What am I supposed to dooooo?!"
Touya: "Huh. So you have things like cars here too."
Ymir: "More or less. Celica modified
a commercially available model."
Aurelie: "Ah, that explains it. No wonder it's so oddly streamlined.
I heard she was the one who kept insisting, right to the end,
on giving the Liebhofen a streamlined shape too."
Kasumi: "Celica really is amazing, isn't she?
Even modifying a car like this..."
Touya: "Well, apparently tinkering with machines
is her life's work."
Ai: "Beep, beep, beep! You two! Why are you using the confusion
to snuggle up to each other?! Come on, separate!"
Kasumi: "Huh? B-but..."
Touya: "Then YOU go sit in the back.
It's cramped because you forced your way in there, isn't it?"
Ai: "Shut up. I can do what I want!"
Aurelie: "Hmmm..."
Ai: "Wh-what?!"
Aurelie: "Nothiiing..."
Arthur: "We're about to enter the capital."
Touya: "Huh. So this is the royal capital."
Kasumi: "It really feels like a big city."
Touya: "Yeah."
Kasumi: "Oh, look! Look over there! It's beautiful..."
Touya: "Hm? Oh, is that something like a jewelry shop?"
Kasumi: "Hey, Touya-chan, later we could... Oh,
this isn't the time for that, is it?"
Touya: "Well, not right now, but if we get some time,
want to take a look?"
Kasumi: "R-really?"
Ai: "Hey! Why have you two switched into sightseeing mode?!"
Touya: "What's got you so irritated all this time?"
Ai: "Nothing!"
Touya: "What's with her?"
Kasumi: "Who knows?"
Aurelie: "...Are you two seriously asking that?"
Touya: "???"
Kasumi: "???"
Aurelie: "In a way, you're a perfect match."
Touya: "So this is the place..."
Kasumi: "It looks like a lovely shop."
Ai: "It loses points for not being an open-air cafe,
but the atmosphere looks nice."
Yamato: "Come on. We're in the way standing around the entrance.
Let's go inside, nyow."
Touya: "Yeah..."
Aurelie: "This is a pretty nice place. Everything fits together
without looking showy. I like this sort of thing."
Arthur: "Still, at lunchtime, the only customers are one girl
and one man...?"
Clovis: "Well, that group of soldiers over there is probably why."
??: "Oh, welcome.
But you might want to give us a miss right now..."
Touya: "Why?"
??: "Look, those soldiers over there... That guy's called Selg,
and the others are his men. They hang around here all day...
They're causing trouble for my sister too.
Thanks to them, the other customers won't come in..."
Kasumi: "Oh, they're looking this way and saying something..."
Ai: "I've got a bad feeling about this..."
Selg: "Well, well... If it isn't our champions of justice.
Can you afford to be slacking off here?
Or did you run away because Ze=Ode scares you?"
Soldier: "So you left the Spirit Mechs behind
and ran away?"
????: "...Spirit Mechs..."
Soldier: "Hey! Why the silence? Say something!"
Aurelie: "...I have nothing to say to lowlifes
who can only make themselves feel superior
by tearing other people down."
Soldier: "Wh-what did you say?! You..."
Selg: "...Stop. Causing trouble here
would only inconvenience Rosalie. Leave it."
Ai: "That doesn't suit you at all..."
Kasumi: "Oh, you think so too, Ai-chan?"
Selg: "...But I'll remember those words, woman."
Aurelie: "Hah! Now you're being sexist?
You really are contemptible through and through."
Selg: "Urgh... Tch. Fine.
I'll let it slide in front of Rosalie.
...Now, Rosalie, where were we...? Huh?"
Soldier: "Lieutenant Colonel, Rosalie is at their table..."
Rosalie: "Thanks. He was getting so persistent, I didn't know what to do."
Clovis: "...Young lady, how old are you?"
Rosalie: "Huh? U-um... Sixteen..."
Clovis: "That old guy's clearly over thirty.
This is a crime."
Aurelie: "...You're over thirty too, aren't you?"
Clovis: "That's my biological age.
In my heart, I'm still twenty-three."
Arthur: "Though mentally, you're still in your early teens."
Clovis: "Hey, don't flatter me so much.
You're making me blush."
Rosalie: "Heh heh heh... You're funny."
Selg: "Rosalie!"
Rosalie: "..."
Selg: "Rosalie!!"
Touya: "That old guy seems to be calling you..."
Rosalie: "Never mind him. Now, what would you like to order?"
Selg: "Hey! I'm calling you!"
Rosalie: "Ow! H-hey, let go!"
Selg: "Just because I've been nice to you,
don't get carried away..."
Ymir: "Don't! You can't cause a scene here..."
??: "Stop it! Let go of my sister!"
Selg: "Shut up!"
Rosalie: "Gen!"
Clovis: "...Touya, Arthur. Let's go."
Touya: "Yeah."
Arthur: "I've been waiting for you to say that."
Clovis: "All right... Hm?"
Selg: "Hm? Who are y..."
Soldier: "L-Lieutenant Colonel!"
Soldier: "You! Do you realize who
you just sent flying with that punch?!"
Soldier: "You're ready for the consequences, aren't you?
Eh, little lady?!"
Touya: "Look out!"
Soldier: "You left your back wide open!"
Clovis: "Here. Touya, use that."
Touya: "Huh? ...All right!"
Rosalie: "Aaaah! That vaaaaase!"
Soldier: "Gah!"
Rosalie: "It was so expensiiiiiive!"
Clovis: "A bunch of grown men ganging up on one girl?
That's hardly admirable. How about taking us on instead?"
Soldier: "Y-you bastards..."
Arthur: "You assaulted the citizens you are supposed to protect...
There is no changing that fact.
If you make a bigger scene here,
I doubt the outcome will be pleasant for you either."
Soldier: "Tch! Y-you'll pay for thiiiiis!!"
????: "Are you all right?"
Rosalie: "Huh? Oh, y-yes. Thank you..."
????: "I don't even want to think about people like that
being the ones protecting this country! Honestly!
...Oh, but was it okay for me to do that?
Was I meddling?"
Gen: "What are you talking about? He comes here all the time
and bothers my sister.
Serves him right."
Rosalie: "He really was causing trouble.
I'm not into that sort of guy, either."
????: "I see. That's a relief."
Rosalie: "I'm Rosalie Theora Mercene.
And you are?"
Gen: "Oh..."
Doris: "...Well... I see......?"
Touya: "...Oh!"
Doris: "...Heh heh."
Ymir: "That woman..."
Doris: "...My apologies for being late.
I've come to collect you."
????: "Oh, r-right..."
Rosalie: "...You know her?"
????: "W-well, yes."
Doris: "Now, allow me to show you the way."
????: "Oh, w-wait!"
Doris: "...This is for the repairs and the trouble.
Please accept it. Good day."
Rosalie: "Oh... Gone already..."
Kasumi: "Hey, Touya-chan, do you know that woman from just now?"
Touya: "Huh?! Oh, yeah...
Right, you hadn't met her.
She's the secretary to the Agarthian Council's chairman."
Kasumi: "...I see."
Arthur: "That would mean the girl from just now
had an appointment to meet Chairman Rakbal."
Clovis: "Why arrange to meet in a place like this...?"
Rosalie: "Sorry our place isn't good enough for you!"
Clovis: "N-no, that's not what I meant.
It was a figure of speech. A slip of the tongue..."
Arthur: "That isn't much of an excuse."
????: "Heh heh heh... All the Spirit Mech pilots, together...
My luck is finally turning..."
Gen: "I'm Genzbariored Mercene."
Kasumi: "Ge... Genz...?"
Gen: "Just Gen is fine, pretty lady."
Kasumi: "O-oh, I'm not that pretty..."
Ai: "Hey, hey, hey! What about me?"
Gen: "Well, I'd better get tomorrow's preparations started..."
Gen: "W-whoa!"
Ai: "...Gen... And how do you think I look?"
Gen: "A v-vewy pwetty... wady..."
Ai: "Good. That's better."
Gen: "Waaah! Siiis!"
Rosalie: "Honestly, how many times have I told you?
Compliment them, even if you have to lie..."
Rosalie: "Ah, ha ha ha ha...
W-well, enjoy yourselves..."
Ai: "What's that supposed to mean?!
How am I inferior to Kasumi?!
Honestly, how rude!"
Kasumi: "H-ha ha ha..."
Lodis: "Hello. Sorry to keep you..."
Ai: "WHAT?!"
Lodis: "Oh, no... I'm sorry I'm late.
But you needn't be quite so angry..."
Ai: "Huh? Oh, Lodis!"
Lodis: "Ha ha ha ha!"
Ai: "What is it?!"
Lodis: "Sorry. I thought it was just like you."
Rosalie: "Oh, welco... Aaaah!!
Y-Y-Your Highness!!"
Lodis: "Shh. I'm here in a private capacity today.
I'd appreciate it if you kept that quiet."
Rosalie: "Y-yes..."
Lodis: "I'm glad there's such a sensible young lady here.
...Thank you."
Rosalie: "So handsome..."
Ai: "Wow, you're good. How many women have you made cry
with that routine?"
Kasumi: "M-made them cry...?"
Lodis: "H-hey, that makes me sound terrible..."
Ai: "Then it's all a complete lie?"
Lodis: "Urgh, well..."
Kasumi: "Th-that's indecent!"
Touya: "...Hm?"
Gen: "Oh, sir! Your change...
Hey, wait! You forgot something! Heeey!
Hey, Sis! Sis!"
Rosalie: "...Oh! Wh-what? What's wrong?"
Gen: "That old guy left something behind."
Kasumi: "That's a big stuffed animal."
Ai: "Eee! It's so cute! A bear! A bear!"
Rosalie: "A bear?"
Ai: "Huh? Oh, yeah. That's what we call it in my country."
Rosalie: "Hmm. Here, we call it an Uluus...
That's unusual.
...But wasn't the person who was sitting here
an old guy with a really stern face?
...That's a little scary, maybe."
Gen: "Never mind that. What do we do with it?
He's already gone."
Rosalie: "Well, he'll come back for it sooner or later.
Let's keep it here until then.
...Besides, the menu sign was getting wobbly.
Won't this do nicely? There. Yes, perfect!"
Gen: "Sis, you just said we'd keep it for him..."
Rosalie: "If you don't work, you don't eat!"
Touya: "I don't think that's quite how it works..."
Growster: "...What do you want at such a busy time?"
Lyle: "Are you really planning to invade Agarthia?
I hear the remnants of York's forces are gathering."
Growster: "Hmph. Leave York to Grad."
Lyle: "But I hear York's knights are still alive.
Isn't it dangerous to leave them free?"
Growster: "Now is the time to strike our sworn enemy, Agarthia!
York can be dealt with however we please."
Lyle: "Agarthia was developing a new model too,
or so I heard."
Growster: "They may think they're hiding it,
but that is utterly futile before Zigrim's vaunted intelligence service.
He should stick to hiding his own head."
Lyle: "...Do you have some personal grudge against
that Agarthian fellow, Revios?"
Growster: "Hmph! That is none of your business.
More importantly, Agarthia's new model
has specifications we cannot ignore.
We must settle this before it is deployed
to the front in earnest..."
Lyle: "So you can make a coolheaded judgment about that, at least."
Growster: "Are you mocking me?
Anyone who cannot accurately assess the enemy's strength is unfit to command."
Lyle: "...So, what reason are you going to give
for declaring war?"
Growster: "The biological weapons sighted in York.
Those are Agarthian weapons. And York is our territory.
In other words, it constitutes a violation of our territory.
I should think that is pretext enough."
Lyle: "That's barely more than picking a fight..."
Growster: "That is what war is.
We will take their capital in one stroke
and show them Zigrim's glory!"
Lyle: "I see. A lightning offensive...
Well, that works for our side too."
Growster: "What problem could there possibly be?
You need only stay here and watch our army's victory."
Lyle: "I'll do that for now...
Then I'll be going."
Growster: "What is that man thinking...?
Well, I will find out in time. More importantly, that dead weight...
Lounging about at his villa at a time like this...
What does he think he's doing as head of state?!"
Growster: "Hm? Who is it? ...Come in."
Baio: "...Excuse me."
Growster: "...Baio. If it's Armored Mechs, I'm not buying."
Baio: "I haven't said anything yet."
Growster: "Isn't that it?"
Baio: "Grrrr... It is true that today
I have come to sell the greatest masterpiece of my life.
Why won't you adopt my Bine Daga?!
It will lose to no Armored Mech!
No, not even a Spirit Mech! No..."
Growster: "Yes, yes, I understand.
But a machine that is so picky about its pilot
is useless as a weapon.
Requiring special training makes it more troublesome than a Spirit Mech.
And what is that price? How many Armored Mechs
do you think we could build for the cost of just one?"
Baio: "So what? It's because you fuss over such trifles
that Agarthia looks down on you.
Adopt Bine Daga, and all those worries will be solved at once!
Right now, I'll even throw in a special Bine Daga maintenance kit!"
Growster: "I told you, I don't want it."
Baio: "Grrrr... Th-then, just this once,
I'll make Bio cover the installment fees
for up to ten payments."
Growster: "That is not the issue.
If you insist, I might consider buying the Daga
you brought along with it."
Baio: "Daga? Well, that one isn't bad either,
but while you're at it, why not Bine Daga too...?"
Growster: "No, no.
Will you sell me the Daga or not?"
Baio: "...Thank you for your business..."
Growster: "...What a persistent man."
Growster: "...Still, Bio said,
'Money is not the only form of profit.'
Is this what he meant...?
Honestly... What does he enjoy about making trouble for his own older brother...?"
Ymir: "...I see. So war with Zigrim
could not be avoided..."
Lodis: "Marshal Revios seems to be rushing development of the new Armored Mech,
but it probably won't be ready before war begins."
Arthur: "Come to think of it, I heard Marshal Revios
was promoting the Gazette Project."
Lodis: "It seems that was a cover
for development of the new Armored Mech."
Ymir: "The Doctor did say his budget
had been cut again..."
Lodis: "That money was probably being diverted straight into development.
Then, once war with Zigrim became certain,
the assembly finally got moving,
allowing the marshal to begin development of the new model
as a national project..."
Clovis: "So he caused the laboratory accident
to wipe out the Gazette Project once he didn't need it anymore?"
Lodis: "I don't know. He does love this country
in his own way, and I would not expect him
to act so hastily...
At any rate, development of the new model is a fact,
and Agarthia will probably continue to take a stance
that does not rule out war.
Also, I was investigating Ze=Ode,
and the name of those terrorists came up."
Touya: "They were called Dawn of an Era or something, right?"
Lodis: "Yes. They had the backing of a Zigrim arms dealer.
But more troubling than that is the apparent presence
of collaborators within the council itself."
Clovis: "If that's true, this goes beyond
a mere terrorist group."
Lodis: "Yes. One reason we're speaking here
is that I cannot speak carelessly in the palace.
And the man they seek as their true ruler
is Ze=Ode's leader,
Bafred Debish."
Ymir: "Could that be why
they attacked us?"
Lodis: "That is almost certainly the case.
But for now, they are undoubtedly a possible lead on Ze=Ode,
just as Zigrim is.
Their movements..."
Touya: "What was that?!"
Gen: "Aaah! There's smoke rising!
Huh? That's an Armored Mech..."
Rosalie: "What?! Where? Oh... Thank goodness.
It doesn't look like it'll affect the shop."
Kasumi: "That's a relief."
Ai: "That's not the point!
Isn't that one of the terrorists' machines?!
Let's get back to the Liebhofen and launch the Spirit Mechs!
The damage will only spread if we leave it like this."
Lodis: "No, there is no need.
We can leave that much to the Security Bureau."
Rosalie: "Isn't it getting closer?!"
Ai: "Hey, what's going on?!"
Lodis: "...Why aren't they deploying?
Has their influence really spread this far?!"
Arthur: "Terrorists... But why...?"
Ai: "The damage's just going to keep spreading.
If the Security Bureau's troops won't act,
we have to do something ourselves!"
Ymir: "But for us to engage in combat in the royal capital..."
Aurelie: "We don't have time to stand here arguing!
I'm not just going to sit back and watch!"
Ymir: "Wait, Aurelie!"
Agree with Aurelie
Stay quiet
Aurelie: "Hey! Say something, will you?!"
Touya: "..."
Aurelie: "Wh... Why aren't you saying anything?!"
Touya: "Calm down a little. If we fight here,
we'll cause more trouble for Lodis
and old Lady Ivel.
And for Ymir, who's traveling with us as the Holy Land's representative."
Ymir: "Touya..."
Aurelie: "..."
Clovis: "...But if we leave things as they are,
the damage will only get worse.
We can't just stand by and watch."
Lodis: "...Clovis may be right.
I'm sorry to ask, but can I leave this to you?"
Ymir: "Your Highness... I'm sorry."
Lodis: "No need. Then I'm counting on you."
Aurelie: "Now you're talking!"
Ymir: "But..."
Touya: "The damage will only get worse if we leave it like this.
We can't just stand by and watch."
Lodis: "...Touya may be right.
I'm sorry to ask, but can I leave this to you?"
Ymir: "Your Highness... I'm sorry."
Lodis: "No need. Then I'm counting on you."
Ai: "Hey, what did all that mean?
Why does Ymir have to feel
so responsible?"
Ymir: "His Highness just asked us to deploy the Spirit Mechs.
He said that as the crown prince.
In other words, our actions are now officially sanctioned
with Prince Lodis's approval."
Yamato: "Oh! Then if we fail or anything,
His Highness will be responsible for all of it, won't he?!"
Ymir: "Not only that. Even if we suppress the attack successfully,
approving the Spirit Mechs' actions will put His Highness
in an even more difficult position."
Clovis: "That's just like that prince..."
Touya: "Damn it! What are we supposed to do?!"
Ymir: "For now, all we can do is give everything we have to stop them.
We mustn't let His Highness's kindness go to waste."
Touya: "Yeah, you're right..."
Fain: "H-hey! What's that smoke?!
Is it Zigrim?!"
Ymir: "We don't know for sure, but it's most likely
those terrorists. Please get ready, anyway."
Celica: "We're already done."
Clovis: "Oh? You certainly work fast."
Celica: "Heh heh heh. Only four machines, though."
Arthur: "Which ones?"
Celica: "Zeifon, Vishal, Parikar,
and Hongshenguang."
Fain: "Whaaat? My Dusseldorf still isn't ready?"
Celica: "That's because you're always pushing it too hard!
Thanks to you, it takes longer to service than the others.
Think about what you've done, will you?"
Fain: "...Yes..."
Touya: "All right! Let's send those four ahead for now!"
Maki: "Huh? What? The Spirit Mechs are moving?
This is my chance! Come on, Reisuke!"
Reisuke: "Beep-boop!"
Maki: "...Huh?
Hey, why isn't it Rayblade?
Well, fine. I'll record it for now... Wait,
they're heading toward the capital!
Come on! I can't film them from here!
...Reisuke, can't you do something?!"
Reisuke: "...Beep-boop..."
Maki: "Aaah, there goes my chance...
All right, we're getting out of here, whatever it takes!"
Touya: "Whoa!"
Ai: "An enemy attack?!"

review_batches.context: The ship is denied docking, the party drives to the capital, and Ai reacts to Touya/Kasumi's closeness. All 516 physical rows examined, including café, political scenes and deployment choices.
review_batches.decisions: Preserve official Holy Land affiliation, Ymir's expectation rather than a guarantee of safety, Celica's field research, Fain's divided loyalty and cramped seating. Keep jealousy as behavior without inventing a confession. One source row per English row; interruptions, interjections and source continuations remain deliberate fragments.

row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o000a1.l01: Investigation permission and docking permission are separate; retain the denial without claiming the investigation itself was banned.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o003a8.l01: Ymir cites official Holy Land affiliation and predicts limited harassment. Her confidence is not narrator proof of immunity.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o0048b.l01: Celica is close to seeing a path to a countermeasure, not reporting that it is already complete.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o00523.l00: Fain is torn between going with Kasumi and staying to protect Celica; neither duty changes to Touya's protection.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o00765.l00: Ai's beep-like interruption is written speech, not a game control or incoming alert.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o007b9.l00: Touya tells Ai to move to the back because she forced her way in, explaining the crowding; don't say Kasumi deliberately created the cramped seating.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o00963.l00: Kasumi starts proposing a later visit to the shop, then checks herself. Keep the interruption before Touya's conditional offer.

review_batches.context: Party enters Rosalie's café; Selg and soldiers taunt them, harass Rosalie and threaten Gen before the unidentified girl acts. Read all 516 rows and the later identity concealment.
review_batches.decisions: Preserve the two/four-question-mark labels until source revelation, Selg's lieutenant-colonel rank, all ages, sexism and the physical let-go demand. Clovis's crime quip is his dialogue, not legal narration. Keep full insults and all hard row boundaries; incomplete thoughts and address-only lines stay deliberate fragments.

row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o00b36.l00: ASCII cafe keeps the existing font repertoire; the distinction is outdoor/open-air seating versus this interior cafe, not coffee quality.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o00c16.l00: One girl and one man are the other customers, in addition to the soldiers. Do not infer names from the anonymous labels.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o00c89.l00: Keep ?? label through Gen's intervention. Rosalie's Gen call precedes the source switching his own label to Gen at 189.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o00d8f.l00: Champions of justice is Selg's sarcastic taunt; do not treat it as an official faction name.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o00e7c.l00: Aurelie insults their need to belittle others; preserve lowlife/contempt force and the explicit sexism accusation at 124.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o0100f.l00: Rank is Lieutenant Colonel, not Colonel; the same rank is kept when the soldiers react to Selg being struck.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o010c6.l00: Rosalie says sixteen; Selg and Clovis are described as over thirty, while Clovis claims a heart age of twenty-three. Keep all distinctions.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o010ed.l01: Clovis calls the age-disparate harassment a crime. Preserve the quip as his speech without importing an external legal judgment.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o012b0.l00: Explicit pain and request to let go retained; do not recast Selg's coercion as consensual flirting.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o01311.l00: Ymir tries to stop a public incident; she is not asking Selg's permission to harass Rosalie.

review_batches.context: The unidentified girl punches Selg; Touya/Clovis/Arthur intervene, Doris escorts her away, another concealed observer speaks and Gen introduces himself. All 516 rows examined, including the stuffed toy and investigation.
review_batches.decisions: Do not assign a single identity to every four-question-mark label. Preserve the girl's unidentified status, vase cost joke, Doris's payment, Arthur's inference and Gen's full name and distorted compliment. Keep every reaction, continuation and interrupted introduction without adding physical detail.

row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o01401.l00: Four-question-mark girl's identity stays hidden. Later soldier/Arthur lines identify her as a girl, but no name or affiliation is inferred.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o0150f.l00: Clovis provides an object; the following vase reaction identifies it. Do not invent a sword or firearm.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o01603.l00: Arthur uses the soldiers' assault on civilians to warn them of consequences. Preserve the rebuke and conditional outcome.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o018ad.l00: The introduction is cut off before a name. Do not fill in the hidden girl's identity.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o0198c.l00: Doris has come to escort the unidentified girl, not to collect Touya or all pilots.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o01a3e.l00: Repair/trouble payment stays nonspecific; do not assert Doris personally broke the vase.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o01b3b.l00: Arthur infers an appointment with Rakbal from Doris's role. Keep this as his conclusion, not a confirmed meeting already shown.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o01c2a.l00: A concealed observer speaks after the girl leaves. Identical ???? placeholder spelling does not establish that these speakers are the same person.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o01c88.l00: Full name follows glossary Genzbariored Mercene; Kasumi's failed repetition and Gen abbreviation remain separate rows.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o01dac.l00: Distorted vewy/pwetty/wady conveys the source's distorted pronunciation under Ai's pressure; no unspoken physical act is added.

review_batches.context: Gen/Rosalie's teasing gives way to Lodis's arrival, the forgotten Uluus toy, then Growster/Lyle's war discussion. Read all 516 rows, including the separate arms-sales and terrorist scenes.
review_batches.decisions: Keep the unknown observer concealed, toy as Uluus versus Ai's bear word, quoted head-hiding joke and the difference between military plans and a stated pretext. Do not collapse characters sharing question-mark labels. Preserve every physical row, interjection, interrupted greeting and deliberate fragment.

row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o01e11.l01: Rosalie says to compliment even if lying, prompting Ai's renewed anger. Keep the insult/comic backfire rather than changing it to sincere praise.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o01f12.l00: Lodis's greeting is cut off by Ai's anger at someone else. His apology reflects the misunderstanding, not proof she was angry at his lateness.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o020b7.l00: Ai teases Lodis about women made to cry. His hesitation is not a narrator-confirmed count or an explicit sexual history.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o0218b.l00: Another concealed customer's silent reaction and departure remain anonymous. Do not retroactively name the earlier girl from the identical label.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o02290.l00: Ai uses her own world's bear word; Rosalie contrasts the local Uluus term. Preserve both for the naming exchange.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o023a1.l03: Rosalie presses the forgotten toy into service for a wobbly menu sign; don't describe it as a gift or a completed sale.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o02643.l02: Keep Growster's head-hiding jibe against Agarthia's side. No wig, baldness mechanism or disguise is explicitly named here.

review_batches.context: Growster's war pretext and Baio's Bine Daga sales pitch, followed by Bio's profit motive and Lodis's account of Gazette Project funding. All 516 rows examined.
review_batches.decisions: Keep Baio/Bio distinct as the older/younger brothers in the glossary, ten-installment fees, free maintenance kit, cheaper Daga purchase and the profiteering aside. Preserve inference versus fact in funding/accident allegations. All boundaries and deliberate continuations remain intact.

row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o027ec.l00: York being their territory and a treaty violation are Growster's claimed casus belli. Lyle explicitly calls it near-manufactured provocation; do not endorse the territorial/legal claim in narration.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o028c2.l00: Lightning offensive describes the proposed speed, without importing a named real-world operation. Lyle says it suits his side, not that he has joined the invasion.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o02991.l01: Dead weight follows the earlier localization of the daylight-lamp insult, now aimed at the head of state at a villa.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o02a71.l00: Baio is the engineer, Bio the separate arms dealer. Their names are not spelling variants in this scene.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o02b67.l03: Special pilot training and unit price are separate procurement objections, not a claim that Spirit Mechs never need training.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o02cb4.l00: Baio offers to make Bio cover fees for up to ten installment payments. Do not make the machine free or assign the fees to the customer.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o02cff.l01: Growster considers ordinary Daga instead of Bine Daga; Baio's sale-closing phrase at 371 signals reluctant agreement, not adoption of both models.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o02e0e.l03: Bio's own older brother is Baio, consistent with both library profiles. Growster is commenting on their relationship, not calling Baio his brother.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o02f89.l00: Gazette Project as development cover and budget diversion are Lodis's apparent/probable account; Clovis's subsequent accident theory remains a question.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o0308f.l00: Clovis alleges deliberate erasure via the laboratory accident. Lodis says he does not know; preserve that disagreement and uncertainty.

review_batches.context: Lodis explains Dawn of an Era's suspected council connections and Debish aim; an attack begins, and two player-choice paths lead to his authorization. Read all 516 rows and the later explanation of his responsibility.
review_batches.decisions: Keep allegations provisional where stated, exact named leader, Security Bureau inaction as observed, and both agree/stay-quiet branches separate. Lodis asks the pilots to act; they do not ask him to fight personally. Preserve all address-only reactions, unfinished thoughts and hard row boundaries.

row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o031ce.l00: Arms-dealer backing and apparent internal council collaborators remain separate allegations; do not identify the unnamed collaborators.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o0325f.p01.l00: The terrorists seek Bafred Debish as true ruler. Keep their objective separate from proof he is already ruling the council or country.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o0330c.l00: Almost certain translates the nine-in-ten idiom without inventing a measured probability; the lead on Ze=Ode is separately asserted as certain.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o038a7.l00: Lodis wonders why Security Bureau forces do not deploy and whether the group's influence reaches them. Do not turn the question into confirmed infiltration.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o039e2.l00: The player can agree with Aurelie or stay quiet. Preserve the following alternate dialogue paths instead of making Touya both silent and outspoken in one sequence.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o03a64.l00: Touya cites consequences for Lodis, Ivel and Ymir to request restraint. Old Lady Ivel preserves his familiar age-based address without changing her title in formal speakers.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o03b39.l01: Lodis asks Clovis/the group to take action; I'm counting on you must retain that direction. The alternate Touya route has the same request at 466-468.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o03d4e.l00: Lodis's request formally sanctions their deployment as crown prince and exposes him to blame, even if the operation succeeds. Keep both points.

review_batches.context: The party explains Lodis's political risk, returns to the ship and launches four ready mechs while Maki tries to film them. Final 36 rows, all 516 examined.
review_batches.decisions: Retain risk even on successful suppression, four exact machine names, Dusseldorf's longer servicing and Maki's inability to film the capital from her current position. Keep explicit uncertainty about the attackers and the last startled question. No source row is merged or shortened for fit.

row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o03f46.l00: The suspected terrorists are not definitively identified yet; don't turn Fain's Zigrim question into a confirmed invasion.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o03fbb.l00: Exactly four machines are ready: Zeifon, Vishal, Parikar and Hongshenguang. Dusseldorf is still being serviced, not destroyed or permanently unavailable.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o040f6.l01: Maki sees a reporting chance, not a combat opportunity. Her later disappointment is that Rayblade is not deploying and the others move out of camera range.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00b.o041e1.l01: Maki resolves to get out of her current hiding place; no completed escape or new location is asserted.
